title: Reproduction code and radiomics feature matrix: incremental value of MRI radiomics for overall survival in glioblastoma (UPENN-GBM cohort)
description: Analysis code and derived PyRadiomics feature matrix for the manuscript "MRI 影像组学对胶质母细胞瘤总生存期的增量价值：UPENN-GBM 队列分析". Includes cohort manifest and registration QC, IBSI fixed-bin-count (binCount=64) feature extraction, nested patient-grouped cross-validation modelling, patient-level bootstrap, calibration with bootstrap 95% intervals, MGMT association decomposition, feature selection stability and sensitivity analyses. Raw images and segmentations are NOT included; they must be obtained from the public UPENN-GBM repository (DOI: 10.7937/TCIA.709X-DN49). The feature matrix is a derivative of that dataset and is shared under CC BY 4.0; the code is MIT licensed.
